explanation.description:
Plain-text explanation of how the content was generated. Supply a
nonblank explanation to offer disclosure. Omit it for a static mark.

generated-at.description: Optional generation date or time, displayed as supplied.

generated-at-label.description: Visible prefix for the generation date or time.

label.description: Short visible provenance text. Localize it with the trigger name.

model.description: Optional plain-text model name shown in the explanation.

model-label.description: Visible prefix for the model name.

popover-label.description: Accessible name of the non-modal explanation panel.

revert-label.description: Visible text and accessible name of the revert action.

revertible.description:
Offer the revert action inside the explanation. Enable it when the
application has the original text and handles `ki-revert`.

size.description: Size of the painted mark. Unknown values use the small metrics.

trigger-label.description: Accessible name of the disclosure button. Include the visible label.

--ki-ai-label-backdrop-filter.description: Complete filter behind the AI provenance mark. Defaults to none.

--ki-ai-label-bg.description: Fill of the AI provenance mark.

--ki-ai-label-bg-image.description: Optional image over the AI provenance fill. Defaults to none.

--ki-ai-label-border-width.description: Border width of the panel and the forced-colors mark.

--ki-ai-label-fg.description: Text and icon ink of the AI provenance mark.

--ki-ai-label-gap.description: Gap between the mark and its icon or between provenance metadata items.

--ki-ai-label-md-height.description: Minimum painted block size of the medium AI mark.

--ki-ai-label-md-icon-size.description: Sparkles icon size in the medium AI mark.

--ki-ai-label-md-padding-inline.description: Inline inset of the medium AI mark.

--ki-ai-label-popover-backdrop-filter.description: Complete filter behind the provenance explanation. Defaults to none.

--ki-ai-label-popover-bg.description: Raised fill of the provenance explanation.

--ki-ai-label-popover-bg-image.description: Optional image over the provenance explanation fill. Defaults to none.

--ki-ai-label-popover-border.description: Hairline color of the explanation panel.

--ki-ai-label-popover-fg.description: Ink of the provenance explanation and metadata.

--ki-ai-label-popover-gap.description: Gap between the panel sections and between the panel and trigger.

--ki-ai-label-popover-radius.description: Corner radius of the explanation panel.

--ki-ai-label-popover-width.description: Preferred inline size of the explanation panel.

--ki-ai-label-radius.description: Corner radius of the AI provenance mark.

--ki-ai-label-sm-height.description: Minimum painted block size of the small AI mark.

--ki-ai-label-sm-icon-size.description: Sparkles icon size in the small AI mark.

--ki-ai-label-sm-padding-inline.description: Inline inset of the small AI mark.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-line-height-para.description: semantic dimension for typography line height para.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

component.description:
A compact provenance mark for AI-generated content, with optional details
and a user-initiated request to restore their original text.

ki-revert.description:
Bubbles when a person requests their original text. Use this request
to restore the original from application state.

label.description: Tinted mark containing the icon and visible text.

trigger.description: Disclosure button, available with an explanation.
